ch44-open.title: My activities
ch44-open.standfirst: A personal log of what you've done in Canvas M — meetings created, invitations answered, joins, and files uploaded.

c44-activities.heading: Everything you've done, in one list
c44-activities.lead: The My activities view (the History icon) keeps a running record of your own actions: meetings you created, invitations you received and how you replied, meetings you joined, and files you uploaded.
c44-activities.body: It's built from your existing data rather than a separate log, so it's always an honest reflection of what happened — handy for retracing “when did I last open that project?”
